item.title: Version 0.21.0
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.21.0

What’s New

  • Beta Updates: Opt in from Preferences > About to get new features early. Free and trial users see the option locked with an upgrade prompt; Pro is required to turn it on.

Improvements

  • AI Out of Beta: The AI preferences pane no longer shows a Beta tag, now that AI features are fully rolled out.

Bug Fixes

  • Backspace, arrow keys, and other composition keys now reach Japanese and other IME input instead of being hijacked by search, folder previews, or rename fields.
  • The “Items to Show” recents setting now stays within 1-100, instead of accepting an out-of-range number typed directly into the field.
  • Pasting a license key via Cmd+V or the right-click menu no longer fails to activate when it carries extra whitespace.
